tooltip_definitions.Total GAAP Revenue: Consolidated GAAP net revenue from Editas Medicine biopharma collaborations, license fees, and research milestones ($10.37M in Q3 2026, beating Street consensus $4.53M by +128.92%).
tooltip_definitions.Collaboration & Licensing Revenue: Contractual research and development fees and upfront license amortization from strategic partners including Bristol Myers Squibb ($10.37M in Q3 2026, up +67.3% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Diluted EPS: GAAP diluted net loss per share of -$0.15 in Q3 2026 based on 153.6M weighted average shares, beating Street consensus (-$0.21) by $0.06.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Burn: Operating cash outflow of -$21.19M in Q3 2026, narrowing significantly from -$29.57M in Q2 2026 and -$30.84M in Q3 2025 due to prudent R&D expense management.
tooltip_definitions.Liquid Cash & Securities Runway: Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaling $190.20M as of September 30, 2026, funding operations into the second half of 2028.
tooltip_definitions.EDIT-401 Strive Study: Editas' wholly-owned, in vivo gene editing medicine targeting LDLR for hyperlipidemia/HeFH; cleared by Australia HREC/TGA for Phase 1/2 Strive trial with dosing initiating in 2026.
tooltip_definitions.AHA Preclinical Durability: New preclinical data presented at American Heart Association (AHA) demonstrating >=90% durable LDL-C reduction sustained over 10 months in non-human primates.
tooltip_definitions.BMS-986527 Milestone: Second IND/CTA accepted for BMS collaboration program (CD70 allogeneic CAR-T therapy using Cas12a for clear cell renal cell carcinoma), triggering a cash milestone to Editas.
tooltip_definitions.Cas12a Patent Estate: Editas' proprietary CRISPR-Cas12a intellectual property portfolio, providing fundamental freedom-to-operate and cross-licensing leverage across oncology and cardiovascular medicine.
tooltip_definitions.Targeted LNP Platform (tLNP): Novel extrahepatic targeted lipid nanoparticle delivery platform presented at ESGCT 2026 demonstrating precise in vivo delivery of mRNA to targeted T-cells.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Loss: GAAP operating loss of -$24.28M in Q3 2026 ($10.37M revenue minus $34.65M operating expenses), improving YoY from -$24.55M.
tooltip_definitions.Research and Development: Laboratory discovery, preclinical pharmacology, and Strive study preparatory costs totaling $21.17M in Q3 2026 compared to $19.78M in Q3 2025.
tooltip_definitions.General and Administrative: Corporate overhead, legal defense, and patent prosecution expenses of $13.48M in Q3 2026 compared to $12.32M in Q3 2025.
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow (-$21.19M) minus capital expenditures (-$0.09M) equals reported negative free cash flow of -$21.28M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity compensation expense of $2.48M in Q3 2026 ($6.87M for 9M 2026).
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Comprehensive economic cash burn subtracting CapEx ($0.09M) and SBC ($2.48M) from OCF (-$21.19M), totaling -$23.76M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.After-Hours Reaction: EDIT stock rose +1.82% to $2.80 in after-hours trading as revenue more than doubled consensus ($10.37M vs $4.53M) and cash runway was reconfirmed into 2H 2028.
tooltip_definitions.Dan Ory Appointment: Appointment of Dan Ory, M.D. as Chief Medical Officer, bringing over 25 years of cardiovascular and genetic medicine expertise to lead the EDIT-401 clinical campaign.
tooltip_definitions.Evercore Fireside Chat: Upcoming institutional presentation scheduled for November 30, 2026 at the 9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference.
